summary: touchAgentToken now re-reads and atomically checks both the hash and user-index entries, returns without writing when either is absent, and the exchange returns 401 on a failed touch; a regression test reproduces the revocation race and verifies the grant stays deleted.

evidence: src/auth_store.ts:1345-1362 adds reads of the hash and user-index keys, returns null if either is missing, and commits with check(hashEntry) and check(userIndexEntry) before writing both records.
src/passport.ts:2180 returns 401 when touchAgentToken returns null, so a revoked grant cannot complete an exchange.
tests/passport_cutover_test.ts:124-183 pauses the exchange read, revokes the grant, and asserts the exchange returns 401, the secret no longer resolves, and the user listing is empty.
